title: EOStage v3 Provider Contract
description: Language-neutral contracts for the staged Rust v3 migration.

provider_product_key.description: Stable Provider-and-Collection-scoped product identity; new mapped products also carry this value in product_key for compatibility.

provider_product_id.description: Opaque product or Item identifier supplied by the Provider and preserved without case normalization.

canonical_product_key.description: Optional reviewed cross-Provider scientific equivalence key; null when no versioned equivalence rule exists.

identity_rule_id.description: Versioned Collection identity profile that selected and interpreted the native identity fields.

logical_dataset.description: Internal logical dataset identity selected by a reviewed route policy.

provider_id.description: Provider-scoped catalogue identity; it is not inferred from a locator host.

native_collection_id.description: Opaque native collection identity retained without cross-provider normalization.

collection_profile_id.description: Versioned profile that owns native-to-normalized interpretation.

filename_rule_id.description: Versioned evidence-based archive filename rule; it does not infer a suffix.

delivery_model.description: Reviewed delivery shape; catalogue discovery does not execute delivery.

production_enabled.description: Explicit route enablement; false keeps a descriptor offline-only.

aoi_geojson.description: Optional EPSG:4326 Polygon or MultiPolygon AOI, optionally wrapped in a reviewed GeoJSON Feature or FeatureCollection. Null means no spatial constraint and must never be replaced by a world bbox.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation value accepted only from a reviewed catalogue response.

result_limit.description: Required user result intent. Finite values request 1 through 10000 admitted products; null means exhaustive ALL and must never be treated as a provider page size or a silent 10000 cap.

filters.description: Provider-neutral query facts only; access material and sensitive keys are rejected.

batch_id.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: the batch this search delivers into, once it is readable (progressive publication, or a terminal update of a search that kept a batch). Null before; absent from older hosts, which read as null.

loaded_count.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: rows of batch_id that have arrived and are pageable; null while no batch is readable. Absent from older hosts, which read as null.

possibly_incomplete.description: #22 B slice 3(a), contract 3.38.0: true on a done search whose frozen batch is possibly incomplete (FrozenSearchStats.truncated): the 10,000 safety ceiling (or ALL, which it bounds) or a provider budget stopped it and remote exhaustion was not proven, or the provider warned it served fewer records than it reported. Meeting an explicit or default target below the ceiling, or exactly N kept with the remote side exhausted, is false. Absent from older hosts, which read as false.

batch_id.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: the batch this search delivers into. Set once the batch is readable: from progressive publication (the first full page of 250 rows staged) while loading, and on the terminal update of a search that froze or kept a batch (done, or cancelled/failed after publication with its arrived rows kept). Null before publication and when no batch exists. Absent from older hosts, which read as null.

loaded_count.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: rows of batch_id that have arrived and are pageable. Null while no batch is readable. Absent from older hosts, which read as null.

remote_total.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: the provider's reported total for the query when the provider offers one (ASF output=count, CMR hits, STAC numberMatched, CDSE $count), surfaced as soon as it is known. Above 10,000 the frozen batch keeps at most the 10,000 ceiling and is possibly incomplete; the user narrows the area or time. Null when unknown. Absent from older hosts, which read as null.

SearchBatchProgressState.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: the delivery state of a progressively published search batch. Batches frozen before 3(c) read as complete.

SearchCancelOutcome.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: the answer of the catalogue search cancel command.

cancelled.description: True when this call owned the live search request and signalled its cancellation; false when the request was already terminal or unknown.

batch_id.description: The batch the cancelled search had made readable, when one exists; null when nothing was published.

state.description: The batch's delivery state after the cancel: cancelled when a loading batch was kept with its arrived rows (possibly incomplete); the earlier terminal state when the search had already sealed it; null when no batch was readable yet (a search cancelled before its first full page leaves no batch).

StoreBatchPageRequest.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: one bounded page of one batch by id, also while it is loading.

StoreBatchPage.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: one bounded page of a batch with per-row task state and the batch's delivery state.

total_count.description: Rows of the batch when the page was served. For a loading batch this is the arrived count, never the provider total.

state.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: the batch's delivery state; batches frozen without progressive publication read as complete. A page that starts at or beyond the arrived rows of a loading batch is refused with the typed V3_STORE_BATCH_PAGE_NOT_YET_LOADED error instead of an empty success.

loaded_count.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: rows that have arrived; equals total_count, named separately so a loading projection stays explicit.

remote_total.description: #22 B slice 3(c), contract 3.41.0: the provider's reported total for a progressively delivered batch, when the provider offers one. Null when unknown or for a batch frozen without progressive publication. Absent from older hosts, which read as null.

warning.description: Admitted with a caveat, e.g. the Earthdata session could not be established yet and the worker will establish it.

codes.description: Distinct stable codes of the failed items, in the order their current failures were recorded; an unreadable code is UNKNOWN_FAILURE_CODE.

message_zh.description: The recorded human message of the first failed item that has one; never synthesized.

kind.description: disk_low: the download engine paused the task because the storage drive of its output root ran low.

free_bytes.description: Bytes available to the application on the drive when the engine paused the task.

threshold_bytes.description: The free-space floor that was not met: max(2 GiB, min(5% of the drive, 50 GiB)), raised to the remaining bytes of the current file + 1 GiB when known.

drive.description: The drive or volume prefix of the task output root, for display only; null when unknown (the UI shows 未知盘符).

source_task_id.description: Orbit scheduled-fetch S4 (plan B): the owning image task this companion task was derived from, projected from the frozen operation payload; null for ordinary tasks and old payloads.

auxiliary_kind.description: Orbit scheduled-fetch S4: the auxiliary row kind of this task, e.g. AUX_POEORB for a companion precise-orbit task; null for ordinary tasks and old payloads.

failure.description: Persisted failure of the task's failed items (download results and mark_failed events), readable after restart; null when no item failed and the task is not failed.

pause_reason.description: Why the engine paused the task, from its latest pause_task event; null when the task is not paused or was paused by the user.

source_task_id.description: Orbit scheduled-fetch S4 (plan B): the owning image task this archived companion task was derived from, projected from the frozen operation payload; null for ordinary tasks and old payloads.

auxiliary_kind.description: Orbit scheduled-fetch S4: the auxiliary row kind of this archived task, e.g. AUX_POEORB for a companion precise-orbit task; null for ordinary tasks and old payloads.

failure.description: Persisted failure of the task's failed items (download results and mark_failed events), readable after restart; null when no item failed and the task is not failed.

requested_limit.description: Maximum number of unique valid products requested for a finite Working Set; null means exhaustive ALL.

matched_count.description: Provider-reported total before page fetch; null when the catalogue does not disclose one.

request_count.description: Number of provider catalogue requests executed for this bounded Working Set.

transport_part_count.description: Number of provider-safe spatial transport parts planned from the immutable canonical AOI.

fetched_record_count.description: Raw records received for this response page before mapping.

mapped_record_count.description: Records successfully mapped by the versioned CollectionProfile before exact-duplicate collapse.

profile_filtered_record_count.description: Provider candidates deterministically excluded before mapping because their authoritative metadata is outside the selected CollectionProfile.

exact_duplicate_record_count.description: Mapped records merged because they are exact duplicates under the versioned provider product identity rule.

unique_provider_product_count.description: Unique mapped provider products after exact-duplicate collapse and before the requested local result limit.

exact_matched_count.description: Unique provider products that pass the canonical AOI and local filter checks before the requested limit.

returned_count.description: Unique mapped products published by this response after the requested limit.

remote_exhausted.description: True only when every relevant remote page and spatial transport part was exhausted.

working_set_satisfied.description: True when the bounded foreground Working Set operation completed successfully. A finite requested limit is a maximum: budget-bounded partial results and valid zero-hit results are successful even when the remote catalogue was not exhausted.

elapsed_ms.description: Elapsed provider catalogue time in milliseconds for this response.

truncated.description: True when a trusted continuation remains after the published page.

next_cursor.description: Trusted opaque continuation for the same reviewed route and query scope.

item_errors.description: Typed per-record mapping failures excluded from products.

resolver_id.description: Exact registered resolver identifier; it is not inferred from the URL host.

scheme.description: Reviewed stable locator scheme used only for deterministic compatible resolver selection.

stable_href.description: Stable non-secret locator; query strings, fragments, userinfo, signed and expiring URLs are forbidden.

requires_credentials.description: Declares whether runtime resolution must request a logical credential profile.

credential_profile.description: Logical credential profile identifier only; no credential material is persisted.

resolver_parameters.description: Strict resolver-specific durable parameters; Phase 3A resolvers accept no additional fields.

asset_key.description: Opaque identity unique within one Provider product; role alone is not an asset identity.

stable_asset_key.description: Stable global asset reference derived from provider_product_key and asset_key without using an access URL.

access_descriptor.description: Optional durable access plan; legacy URL-only assets remain readable when this field is null.

native_roles.description: Observed provider-native role strings in deterministic source order. They preserve provenance only; only a versioned CollectionProfile may map them to the closed normalized role.

PreviewKind.description: Scientific preview presentation class; it does not select a downloadable asset.

PreviewCredentialRequirement.description: Whether a separate reviewed Preview resolver must supply Provider credentials.

PreviewCachePolicy.description: Maximum cache lifetime permitted for the rendered Preview, independent of download caching.

PreviewDescriptor.description: Non-executable Preview recipe over identified assets; access URLs and credentials are resolved at runtime.

source_asset_keys.description: Stable Provider asset keys or product-scoped runtime discovery identities used by this Preview; never download-selection aliases.

render_profile_id.description: Versioned renderer or pass-through policy identifier.

media_type.description: Expected media type of the rendered Preview.

provenance.description: User-inspectable origin and rendering statement; it must not contain secrets.

PreviewAssetRole.description: Closed role vocabulary admitted by the shared Preview resolver.

PreviewErrorKind.description: Stable fail-closed Preview failure classification exposed to the UI.

PreviewAssetRequest.description: Request for a Preview resolved from an authoritative frozen SearchBatch item.

ResolvedPreviewAsset.description: Validated Preview bytes and provenance resolved without exposing Provider credentials or signed URLs.

source_asset_key.description: Selected renderable Provider asset key or product-scoped runtime discovery identity; never a fabricated download-asset key.

data_url.description: Validated in-memory data URL returned to the desktop UI; never a Provider access URL.

footprint_geojson.description: Optional authoritative polygonal Provider footprint. It is distinct from the submitted catalogue AOI; footprint_bbox remains only a derived convenience.

matched_count.description: Provider-reported matches before records are fetched; null when unavailable.

fetched_record_count.description: Remote records fetched before mapping; null when the route cannot report it.

mapped_record_count.description: Records successfully mapped before publication; null when the route cannot report it.

provider_returned_count.description: Provider products returned after its result limiting.

frozen_candidate_count.description: Candidates persisted in this frozen batch.

truncated.description: Whether the provider response omitted additional matching products.

source.description: Canonical fixed search route label; never a provider locator or credential.

source_attempts.description: Bounded, secret-free source attempts for this live request only. Cache reuse must not fabricate or replay attempts from an earlier request.

search_stats.description: Optional bounded provider search facts kept separate from frozen candidates.

aoi_geojson.description: Optional frozen search AOI. Null means the user ran an explicit global/no-spatial-constraint search and must not be replaced by a world bbox.
Optional frozen search AOI. Null preserves an explicit global/no-spatial-constraint task across persistence migration.

LocalReuseDisposition.description: Downloader D3: reused, renamed aside as a conflict, or to be downloaded again.

LocalReuseGrade.description: Downloader D3: the evidence a reuse rests on; size_and_format has no content evidence.

OrbitRecheckInfo.description: Orbit scheduled-fetch S4: the persisted scheduled-recheck projection of one waiting companion precise-orbit item. A projection of the Store's orbit_recheck_schedule row; the UI displays next_check_at but never computes or counts it down (UI-REG-003).

expected_file_name.description: The complete EOF file name once the provider has resolved it; null before publication (the name is never guessed from acquisition time, SAR-REG-006).

StoreTaskItemLocalReuse.description: Downloader D3: how a task item met an existing file at its planned destination.

conflict_file_name.description: The file name (never a path) the conflicting file was renamed to.

source_total_bytes.description: Frozen source size, independent of output/progress total; null when unknown.

local_reuse.description: Downloader D3: the item's local reuse decision; null when none.

orbit_recheck.description: Orbit scheduled-fetch S4: the item's persisted scheduled recheck; null when the item is not a waiting companion precise-orbit item.

source_total_bytes.description: Sum of frozen sizes of all selected task items, independent of the visible page; null if any size is unknown or the sum overflows.

network_bytes_received.description: Persisted lifetime HTTP body bytes for this task; null means no measurement, while zero is an observed value.

path.description: The conflict file's path relative to the task output root; separators are the platform's own.

modified_at_epoch_ms.description: The file's last modification time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

recorded.description: True when the Store recorded this conflict name as a renamed-aside local reuse decision.

reacquire_item_ids.description: Downloader D3: items to download again instead of reusing an existing file, which is renamed aside and kept.

requested_limit.description: Maximum number of unique Provider products requested by the caller for this response.

query_limit.description: Remote record limit used by the compatibility query plan; retained for existing readers.

metadata_request_count.description: Metadata HTTP requests issued by the foreground search, excluding an independently scheduled background count request.

total_count.description: Legacy Provider match total; new consumers should read matched_count.

candidate_count.description: Legacy ambiguous candidate count retained for compatibility and not used to explain identity reduction.

returned_count.description: Number of unique Provider products actually published after mapping, conflict rejection, limiting, and truncation.

source.description: Search route that produced the response, such as ASF, ASF_BATCH, or the explicit compatibility fallback.

cmr_enriched.description: Whether the legacy Sentinel metadata path used CMR enrichment; null when not applicable.

matched_count.description: Provider-reported count matching the query before pages are fetched; null when the Provider does not report it.

fetched_record_count.description: Raw remote records received across all pages or time segments, including exact replayed records.

replayed_record_count.description: Exact remote records replayed across pages or segments and removed before Collection mapping.

mapped_record_count.description: Remote records successfully mapped by a versioned Collection identity profile before product aggregation.

mapping_error_count.description: Records rejected during Collection mapping; equals the number of item_errors under the current one-error-per-record rule.

aggregated_asset_record_count.description: Mapped asset records considered during idempotent product-and-asset aggregation, including duplicate asset records.

unique_provider_product_count.description: Stable Provider products remaining after exact replay removal, asset aggregation, and identity-conflict rejection, before the requested limit is applied.

asset_count.description: Unique stable assets attached to the successfully aggregated Provider products; may exceed the product count.

identity_conflict_count.description: Proposed Provider identities rejected because critical native identifiers or scientific metadata conflict.

page_size.description: Provider page size used for this search behavior; null only for legacy responses that did not report it.

truncated.description: True when additional matched unique products exist beyond returned_count or the requested limit.

item_errors.description: Typed per-record mapping and identity errors that were not published as successful products.

warnings.description: Non-fatal structured diagnostics that do not turn a mapped product into a failure.

bbox.description: Bounding box in EPSG:4326 [west, south, east, north]
Bounding box in EPSG:4326 [west, south, east, north]

admin_code.description: Administrative boundary code returned by admin_boundary_search (for example 510000 for Sichuan).

country_code.description: ISO country code when resolving an administrative boundary outside default China lookup.

bbox.description: Explicit [west, south, east, north] WGS84 bounding box when binding a rectangle directly.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable label for the working area.

clear.description: When true, clears the active working area of interest.

thinking_text.description: Sanitized model reasoning text captured before this assistant message; null or absent when no reasoning occurred.

thinking_ms.description: Elapsed monotonic reasoning duration in milliseconds; null or absent when no reasoning occurred.

started_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the host started this tool call; the same value on the running and the final round.

duration_ms.description: Host-measured duration of the call; null while running.

result_count.description: Search tools only: products this call returned (batch or workbench page items, or the products a finished search kept); null otherwise.

summary_zh.description: The service's own message for the result (search progress message_zh); never synthesized, otherwise null.

target_label.description: Sanitized concise target identifier shown inline on the agent tool row.

input_summary.description: Sanitized bounded summary of tool input arguments for clickable row inspection.

output_summary.description: Sanitized bounded summary of tool output for clickable row inspection; null while running.

disclosure.description: search_start steps only: the external source and conditions the search asks (it runs without a click in every permission mode, A1 design 3.1); absent on other steps and on events written before contract 3.30.0.

display_name_zh.description: The source's display name from the service's source list (SourceDescriptor.display_name_zh) when the plan was proposed, so the card names the source before the UI has loaded that list; null when the list could not be read or does not name resource_id, and absent on events written before contract 3.32.0.

approval.description: How this plan is decided under the session's permission mode (A1 design 3.1); absent on events written before contract 3.28.0.

auto_executed.description: True when the permission mode approved the plan and the host started it without a click. The card shows it as executed automatically with a cancel action: 取消 = 取消本次运行并取消其创建的任务（agent_stop_all 或运行级取消+任务取消）; the tasks a step created are in AgentProgressCard.created_task_ids.

output_dir.description: Where the create_task writes (task control cards: the task's output root); null when neither the plan nor the default download directory names one, in which case the card must choose a directory in every permission mode (agent_plan_approve output_dir).

output_dir_source.description: create_task cards: where output_dir came from; null when output_dir is null, on task control cards and on cards frozen before contract 3.30.0.

result_count.description: Products of the frozen selection this card commits (create_task item_ids); null for task control cards.

already_queued_count.description: Products of that selection already in a live task of the same batch as of plan proposal, by the create_task admission rule (any such product makes create_task return the existing task with created=false); null for task control cards.

orbit_directions.description: Distinct orbit directions recorded on the covered products (Ascending, Descending; other recorded values verbatim); empty when no product records one (shown as unknown). A query filter is never reported as a product fact.

source_display_name_zh.description: The source's name for the user (SourceDescriptor.display_name_zh of the registry resource the frozen batch or task came from, the name the search plan card's disclosure uses); null when the frozen query maps to no listed source and on cards frozen before contract 3.34.0. Part of the frozen card: approval echoes it.

source_resource_id.description: Registry resource_id resolved from the frozen batch or task query; null when unmapped.

selected_items_preview.description: Compact bounded preview of the selected products in this confirm card.

approval.description: How this plan is decided under the session's permission mode (A1 design 3.1); absent on events written before contract 3.28.0.

auto_executed.description: True when the permission mode approved the plan and the host started it without a click. The card shows it as executed automatically with a cancel action: 取消 = 取消本次运行并取消其创建的任务（agent_stop_all 或运行级取消+任务取消）; the tasks a step created are in AgentProgressCard.created_task_ids.

created_task_ids.description: Tasks this step created (create_task with created=true); empty otherwise. A card's cancel action targets these tasks.

trace_sequence.description: 0-based index into agent_runs_open events; not a tool-step ordinal. The later of the last tool_result whose summary names this task or batch and, for a task, the last execution event naming it; null when the run recorded neither (always for web).

response_count.description: Items that step returned when it was a search read (same rule as AgentToolRoundPayload.result_count); null otherwise.

reasoning_off_refused.description: True when, in this run, a provider refused the channel's reasoning-off switch and the host resent that request once without it (run record: model_resend, then a second model_call): the model may have thought before answering although the channel says off. Absent on conclusions written before contract 3.31.0.

thinking_text.description: Sanitized model reasoning text captured on the concluding step; null or absent when no reasoning occurred.

thinking_ms.description: Elapsed monotonic reasoning duration in milliseconds for the concluding step; null or absent when no reasoning occurred.

approval.description: Set on the plan_refused_forbidden error (the proposal named a tool outside the catalog, the forbidden tier, refused in every mode).

message_zh.description: One plain sentence for the user when the host itself ended the run (outbound_blocked, step_limit, repeated_tool_call, tool_not_offered, tool_repeated_result, model_truncated, record_failed); null for provider codes (model_*), which the desktop explains by code. Absent on errors written before contract 3.33.0.

field_class.description: Only on outbound_blocked: which part of the request body the outbound check refused, by class, never its content: system_prompt, user_message, assistant_message, tool_call, tool_result, tool_schema or request_envelope.

AgentPermissionMode.description: Who approves tier 1 and tier 2 Agent plans (A1 design 3.1, Owner 2026-10-26): confirm_changes = every tier 2 plan waits for the desktop card (new users); auto_approve = a tier 2 plan runs without a click unless it has a card reason (AgentCardReason); full_access = everything runs without a click except a create_task whose output directory is unknown or model-suggested and a tier 1/2 tool the gate has no facts for. search_start (tier 1) runs without a click and is disclosed in every mode; the forbidden tier is refused and the tool list is the same in every mode. A mode carries no limits and no directory.

AgentOutputDirSource.description: model_suggested: the plan named the directory itself (shown as 模型建议的目录; the model never sees a directory from the user's message, so the card confirms it in every permission mode); default: the default download directory (the storage root setting); chosen_on_card: the user chose it on the confirm card and the plan was rewritten before approval; from_message (contract 3.32.0): the host took the directory from the user's message before anything was sent to the model, and the plan named it as {"ref": "message_dir"}; like default it is known to the permission gate without the card.

session_override.description: The session's own mode; null when it follows the global default.

AgentCardApproval.description: manual: the card waits for the user's click; auto_by_mode: the mode approved the plan (agent_approvals.decided_via = auto_by_mode); refused_forbidden: a forbidden-tier tool was named and nothing was planned. mode is the session's effective mode at the decision.

card_reasons.description: manual decisions only: every fact of the plan that keeps it from approval under auto_approve, in this order: output_dir_unknown (no directory; the card must choose one, in every mode), output_dir_unverified (the directory was suggested by the model; the card confirms or changes it, in every mode), size_unknown (a selected product has no recorded size), reopens_existing_task (a selected product is already in a live task, create_task would return it), account_not_ready (a needed account has no saved credential or its service is unavailable), selection_not_from_run (the batch was not frozen by a search this run started), targets_user_task (a task control names a task no Agent run created), archive_requires_confirm, ledger_edit_requires_confirm (an update_download_task command other than task- or item-level pause/resume/retry/cancel, e.g. mark_completed, mark_failed, mark_skipped, reacquire_items), tool_requires_confirm (a tier 1/2 tool the gate has no facts for; the card in every mode). Empty when there is none (e.g. a complete create_task under confirm_changes) and on auto_by_mode and refused_forbidden.

AgentStopAllResult.description: agent_stop_all result, also the payload of the stop_all stream event in each affected session: in-progress runs cancelled, active tasks an Agent run created (create_task with created=true) cancelled through the task cancel path, and such tasks whose cancel was refused (after one retry on a revision race). One failure never stops the rest; failed_runs are runs whose cancel could not be completed or recorded.

AgentActivityStatus.description: agent_activity_status result (contract 3.32.0), also the payload of the activity_changed stream event: what agent_stop_all would stop now, across sessions. live_runs = runs in progress or waiting for a desktop card; agent_active_tasks = tasks an Agent run created (create_task with created=true, read from the run records once on first use, and again on the next call if that read hit an unreadable record, then collected by the host when a create_task lands) that are queued, running, paused or interrupted; sessions_with_live_runs = their session ids, sorted. The host announces a change, when it starts or seals a run (or a run fails to start), when a run's create_task lands, after agent_stop_all and after a session is deleted, in the session concerned and in every session that has or just stopped having a live run; it does not observe a task finishing on its own (call agent_activity_status when the task list changes).

model.description: Contract 3.36.0: the channel, model and thinking level picked in the composer; null uses the default channel.

reasoning_level.description: A level of the model's reasoning_levels; "off" uses the per-family switch; null keeps the channel's reasoning_mode.

value.description: What the request carries: reasoning_effort (chat), reasoning.effort (responses) or an Anthropic thinking token budget; null sends no thinking field.

request.description: The user's message that started the run (first 120 characters).

created_task_ids.description: Download tasks the run created (not ones it reused).

permission_mode.description: This session's permission mode; absent or null follows the global default.

pinned_at.description: When the user pinned the session; pinned sessions are listed first.

archived_at.description: When the user archived the session; archived sessions are listed only when asked for.

workspace_id.description: The workspace the session belongs to; null is the unfiled group.

remembered_output_dir.description: Most recent valid local download directory named by the user in this session or confirmed on a card; local desktop persistence only, never sent to model providers.

last_run_status.description: Status of the session's latest run when known (live runs report running or awaiting_approval; stored runs map completed, failed, and cancelled/interrupted).

folder.description: Local folder bound to the workspace; the default download folder offered on its confirm cards (Owner 2026-10-30), never applied without the card.

file_name.description: Suggested file name; the desktop asks the user where to save it.

reasoning_off_refused.description: True when, in this run, a provider refused the channel's reasoning-off switch and the host resent that request once without it (the same rule as AgentConclusion.reasoning_off_refused, also set on runs that failed, were cancelled or were interrupted). From the run row the host sealed (Store schema 36); false on runs sealed before contract 3.32.0.

truncated.description: True when a model reply of this run was cut off at the output limit (run record model_reply truncated); such a run failed with model_truncated and has no conclusion. From the sealed run row (Store schema 36); false on runs sealed before contract 3.32.0.

usage_total.description: Token usage the model channel reported over this run's replies (run record model_reply usage, summed into the sealed run row, Store schema 37); null when no reply reported usage and on runs sealed before contract 3.34.0.

prompt.description: Prompt (input) tokens summed over the replies that reported them; null when none did.

completion.description: Completion (output) tokens summed over the replies that reported them; null when none did.

AgentReasoningMode.description: Whether a model channel lets a reasoning model think before it answers (W3h, contract 3.31.0). off = the request asks the provider to skip its thinking phase where the protocol and model family have a known switch (chat_completions glm-*: thinking {type: disabled}; OpenAI gpt-5 / o-series: the lowest reasoning effort); default = no reasoning field is sent. New channels and channels saved before 3.31.0 are off. When a provider answers HTTP 400 to a request that carried the switch, the host archives and sends that request once more without it and the run's conclusion says reasoning_off_refused.

reasoning_mode.description: Always projected since contract 3.31.0; absent only from hosts older than 3.31.0, which read as off.

reasoning_switch_unsupported.description: W3o (contract 3.34.0): the provider answered HTTP 400 to a request that carried the reasoning-off switch and the resend without it succeeded, so the channel remembers it: its requests carry no switch (and chat glm-* gets max_tokens 8192 instead of 4096), no model_resend is made, and each reply still reports reasoning_off_refused. Cleared when the channel is saved with a different protocol, base_url or model. Absent from older hosts, which read as false.
